record.field: Search for Odoo records in a specific model using a domain.
Create a new record in an Odoo model.
Update an existing Odoo record by ID.

Remove the link between an Odoo record and one or more related records on a many2many or many2one field, without deleting either record. For many2many fields provide a list of related_ids to detach. For many2one fields the field is simply cleared.
Permanently delete an Odoo record by its ID. Use with caution — this action is irreversible. Requires explicit confirmation from the user before execution.
Fetch records from an Odoo model and send them to an AI provider to answer a question about the data (e.g. summarize, compare, detect anomalies).
Send a prompt to the configured AI provider and return the response. Optionally specify a provider name or model to target.
